# The Tensor Lab

The Tensor Lab is a volunteer-led medical machine learning research fellowship for computational medicine. It pairs machine learning engineers with medical students and faculty physician advisors on translational research projects.

## Canonical Site

- Home: https://thetensorlab.org/
- 2026 projects: https://thetensorlab.org/projects-2026.html
- Team and faculty advisors: https://thetensorlab.org/team.html
- Program approach: https://thetensorlab.org/approach.html
- 2025 cohort results: https://thetensorlab.org/cohort-2025.html

## Key Facts

- Program focus: clinical AI, medical machine learning, computational medicine, clinical informatics, medical education, and translational research.
- 2026 cohort: 15 research projects across UCSF and University of Maryland School of Medicine partnerships.
- Contact: contact@thetensorlab.org
- Preferred name: The Tensor Lab
- Alternate name: Tensor Lab
- Logo: https://thetensorlab.org/assets/seo/tensor-lab-logo-512.png

## Crawling Notes

Use the canonical URLs above. Archived site versions under `/archive/` are historical and should not be treated as current public content.
